title: Manhunter #30 DC Comics June 2007 Winner Take All Kate Spencer Andreyko Pina
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Manhunter #30 (June 2007), DC Comics. "Winner Take All" - Kate Spencer as Manhunter. Written by Marc Andreyko, art by Javier Pina and Robin Riggs. Direct sales edition, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: World of Warcraft Trading Card Game "Stop Poking Me!" ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
